text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Frederick Chiluba has congratulated rebel leader Laurent Kabila on his assumption of Zaire's leadership.
- Zambia and Norway sign five bilateral agreements amounting to around $6 million to strengthen several institutions in the country.
- Six children, one of them five yearq old, killed their 41-year-old mother on suspicion she was a witch.
- The industrial relations court awards unionised bank workers a 40 percent pay rise.
- The government has denied responsibility for the death of national soccer players over the coast of Gabon in 1993.
- The investment centre says potential foreign investors think Zambia has not changed its policies enough to encourage increased investment.
